core_obligations: Construct the double complex (proof lines 1486-1495): the author forms the double complex whose columns are the Cech complexes with coefficients in an injective resolution of F, which computes both the Cech cohomology with coefficients in the cohomology presheaves and the cohomology of F on U.
Identify the E_2 page (proof lines 1495-1500): taking cohomology in one direction first gives Cech cohomology with coefficients in the cohomology presheaves, which is the displayed E_2 page.
Convergence and functoriality (proof lines 1500-1503): the convergence to H^{p+q}(U, F) and the functoriality in F follow from the construction of the double complex.
proof_roadmap: Build the double complex from the Cech complex and an injective resolution.
Compute the E_2 page as the Cech cohomology with coefficients in the cohomology presheaves.
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the Cech-to-cohomology spectral sequence of a covering, with E_2 page the Cech cohomology with coefficients in the cohomology presheaves, converging to the cohomology of the covered object, functorially in the sheaf (statement lines 1474-1484). The proof builds the relevant double complex from the Cech complex and an injective resolution (proof lines 1486-1495), identifies the E_2 page (proof lines 1495-1500) and reads off convergence and functoriality (proof lines 1500-1503). The non-formal content is the identification of the E_2 page. The claim is H2: one double complex and one page computation.
